key_idea: Count the separate pieces of ribbon in the picture.
steps: There is a gap between every two pieces, so each orange rectangle is one piece.
The thin line down the middle of each piece is just a stripe on the ribbon. It is not a cut.
Count the pieces from left to right: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8.

choice_feedback.A: Count again from left to right. There are more than 6 pieces.
choice_feedback.B: Count again from left to right. There are more than 7 pieces.
choice_feedback.D: Count again from left to right. There are fewer than 9 pieces.
choice_feedback.E: Count again from left to right. There are fewer than 10 pieces.

review.note: Figure just shows 8 separate ribbon pieces, so the question is only counting (no cutting idea left). Each piece also has a darker stripe down its middle that a child could mistake for a cut. Key C (8) is confirmed by counting. Consider removing the stripes or showing the whole ribbon with cut lines.
